auth.mobileHint: Indian numbers can be entered without +91.

auth.verifySubtitle: If {{destination}} has admin access, a 6-digit code is on its way.
auth.codeResent: A new code has been sent.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.otpInvalidRemaining_one: That code is not correct. {{count}} attempt left.
errors.otpInvalidRemaining_other: That code is not correct. {{count}} attempts left.
errors.otpExpired: That code has expired. Request a new one.
errors.otpTooManyAttempts: Too many incorrect attempts. Request a new code.
errors.otpCooldown: Please wait {{seconds}} seconds before requesting another code.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.providerUnavailable: We could not send your code right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.featureDisabled: This sign-in method is not available.
errors.identityInUse: This is already linked to another account.
errors.validation: Please check the details and try again.
errors.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.notConfigured: This service is not set up yet. A super admin can set it up in System → Integrations.

forbidden.title: You do not have access to this section
forbidden.body: Ask a super admin if you need this access.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.emptyTitle: Analytics are not part of your role
dashboard.emptyBody: Use the sections in the navigation. Business KPIs, costs and margins are shown to super, operations and finance admins.

admins.title: Admin users
admins.inviteHint: They sign in with this email and a one-time code. Every change is recorded in the audit log.
admins.invited: {{email}} now has admin access and has been emailed.
admins.invitedNoEmail: {{email}} now has admin access, but the invitation email could not be sent. Let them know directly.
admins.revokeExplain: {{email}} will lose admin access and be signed out of the admin console. Their candidate account is not affected.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Security events and admin actions, newest first. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.

ai.title: AI providers
ai.subtitle: Which models serve each product feature, their keys, prices and health. Changes apply to every server immediately and are recorded in the audit log.

providers.keyHint: Stored encrypted. After saving, only the last 4 characters are ever shown again.
providers.removeExplain: Models from {{name}} will be skipped until a new key is added. Calls fall back to the next model in each route.
providers.disableExplain: While {{name}} is disabled its models are skipped and calls fall back to the next model.

keyHints.openai: Create a key at platform.openai.com → API keys. OpenAI keys start with “sk-”.
keyHints.anthropic: Create a key at console.anthropic.com → API keys. Anthropic keys start with “sk-ant-”.
keyHints.gemini: Create a key in Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com → Get API key).
keyHints.deepgram: Create a key in the Deepgram console (console.deepgram.com → API Keys). It is a 40-character hexadecimal string.
keyHints.elevenlabs: Create a key at elevenlabs.io → Developers → API keys. If you restrict its scope, allow Text to Speech. ElevenLabs keys start with “sk_”.

models.paramsSummary: Timeout {{timeout}} s · {{retries}} retries · {{concurrency}} concurrent · max output {{maxOutput}} tokens
models.priceHint: Prices are never edited in place: this adds a new entry. Calls already recorded keep the price that applied at the time.
models.disableExplain: Disabled models are skipped in every route.
models.enableExplain: This model will serve calls in the routes that include it.
models.addHint: Use the exact model id from the provider’s documentation. Add its prices before routing traffic to it.

params.hint: Leave temperature empty for models that reject sampling parameters (current Claude models).
params.speechHint: Speech models do not use temperature or output-token limits.
params.voiceHint: Applies to text-to-speech models only: the provider’s voice id (for example an ElevenLabs voice id). Leave empty to use the provider default (ElevenLabs “Rachel”, OpenAI “alloy”).

routes.noEligible: No models have the {{capability}} capability yet. Add one under Models & pricing.
routes.hint: Calls try each model in order, skipping models that are disabled, have no key or are failing. If every model fails, the feature reports that AI is unavailable; it never makes up an answer.

features.interview_assessTurn: Assess an answer and decide on follow-ups

health.explain: Status is the latest 5-minute window (refreshes every 30 seconds). An open circuit means the model failed repeatedly; it is skipped for a short time, then one test call is let through.

usage.title: AI usage & cost
usage.subtitle: Every provider call is metered with the price that applied at the time, including failed and retried calls.
usage.empty: No AI calls in this period.

prompts.title: Prompts
prompts.subtitle: Versioned prompt templates. A version’s text can never change after it is saved; activate a new version instead. Interviews record the exact version they used.
prompts.variablesHint: Use {{example}} placeholders. Text supplied by candidates is inserted inside protected data blocks automatically.
prompts.activateExplain: v{{n}} becomes the version used for {{key}}; the current active version is retired.
prompts.empty: No prompts yet. Prompts arrive with the features that use them (Phase 3 onward).

library.slugHint: Lower-case words separated by hyphens, e.g. backend-engineer.

errors.slug: Use 2–60 lower-case letters or digits, with single hyphens between words.
errors.url: Enter a full http:// or https:// address.

editor.invalidJson: The content is not valid JSON: {{error}}

roles.title: Roles
roles.subtitle: The canonical role library. Each role has versioned blueprints that define what its interviews assess; interviews record the exact version they used.
roles.aliasesHint: Other titles candidates use for this role, separated by commas.

errors.title: Enter a title of 2–120 characters.
errors.slugTaken: That slug is already used by another role.

blueprints.empty: This role has no blueprint yet. Create the first version.
blueprints.newHint: Starts from the active version. Saving creates a draft; activate it once reviewed.
blueprints.totalBad: Weights total {{total}} of 100 — they must total exactly 100.
blueprints.totalUnknown: Weights cannot be totalled until the content is valid JSON with a competencies list.
blueprints.activateExplain: {{version}} becomes the blueprint new interviews for this role use; v{{n}} is retired.
blueprints.activateFirst: {{version}} becomes the blueprint new interviews for this role use.
blueprints.activated: {{version}} is now the active blueprint for {{title}}.

diff.label: Differences between {{version}} and active v{{n}}
diff.explain: Changes in this version compared with the active version (v{{n}}).
diff.identical: No differences from the active version (v{{n}}).

aiBlueprints.subtitle: Blueprints generated for candidates’ job targets. Review good ones and promote them into a canonical role as a draft.
aiBlueprints.promoteExplain: The content is copied into the chosen role as a new draft version. The candidate’s inputs are not copied.

companies.title: Companies
companies.subtitle: Company profiles and verified notes about how they interview. Only verified notes influence interviews, and each keeps its source and verifier.
companies.name: Name
companies.categoriesHint: Interviews for this company only ask questions in these categories.
companies.patternsHint: Only add notes you have verified. Saving records you as the verifier of new or changed notes.

errors.name: Enter a name of 2–120 characters.
errors.slugTaken: That slug is already used by another company.

templates.title: Templates
templates.subtitle: Interview templates: rounds, durations, scoring weights, proctoring and reporting. Versions never change after saving; activate a new version instead.
templates.name: Name
templates.weightsBad: Weights total {{total}}% — they must total exactly 100%.
templates.activateExplain: {{version}} becomes the version of {{key}} used by new interviews; the current active version is retired.

problems.title: Coding problems
problems.subtitle: The problem bank for coding rounds: statement, starter code, visible and hidden tests, and judge limits. Versions are immutable: editing creates a new inactive version, and activating it makes it the one new interviews get. Changes are recorded in the audit log.
problems.editorHint: Saving creates a new inactive version. New interviews keep getting the active version until you activate this one.
problems.keyHint: 3–60 lower-case letters, digits and -, e.g. two-sum.
problems.statementHint: Plain text. Separate paragraphs with a blank line; wrap inline code in backticks, e.g. `nums`.
problems.tagsHint: Comma-separated, up to 10, e.g. arrays, hashing.
problems.chooseLanguage: Choose at least one language to add starter code.
problems.visibleTestsHint: 1–5 examples candidates can see and run. Input is sent to stdin; output is compared exactly, including spaces and newlines.
problems.hiddenTestsHint: 1–30 tests used to judge submissions. Candidates only see how many passed. Output is compared exactly, including spaces and newlines.
problems.noActive: No active version: new interviews do not get this problem.
problems.activateExplain: New interviews will get {{version}} of {{key}}, replacing the version that is active now.
problems.activateInProgress: Interviews that already have this problem keep the version they started with.
problems.deactivateExplain: New interviews will not get {{key}} until another version is activated.
problems.created: Created {{key}} {{version}} (inactive). Activate it so new interviews get it.
problems.activated: {{key}} {{version}} is now active. New interviews get this version.

errors.title: Enter a title of 3–120 characters.
errors.tags: List up to 10 tags of 2–40 characters each.
errors.starterCode: Keep starter code to 8000 characters per language.
errors.visibleTests: Add 1–5 visible tests; input and expected output up to 20,000 characters, explanations up to 500.
errors.hiddenTests: Add 1–30 hidden tests; input and expected output up to 20,000 characters each.
errors.cpuMs: Enter a whole number of milliseconds from 100 to 10000.
errors.memoryMb: Enter a whole number of megabytes from 16 to 1024.

errors.providerUnavailable: The payment provider is not responding. Try again in a few minutes.

plans.title: Plans
plans.subtitle: Credit packs offered on the pricing page. Versions are immutable: editing creates a new inactive version, and activating it puts it on sale in place of the previous one. Changes are recorded in the audit log.
plans.editorHint: Saving creates a new inactive version. Activate it to put it on sale; existing purchases keep the terms they were bought with.
plans.codeHint: Upper-case letters, digits and _ only, e.g. PRO_10.
plans.name: Name
plans.priceHint: In rupees, e.g. 499 or 1,499.50. 0 makes the plan free (not purchasable).
plans.validityHint: Leave empty for credits that never expire.
plans.notOnSale: Not on sale: no version is active.
plans.activateExplain: v{{version}} goes on sale for {{code}}, replacing the version currently on sale. Existing purchases are not affected.
plans.deactivateExplain: {{code}} will not be sold until another version is activated. Existing purchases are not affected.
plans.created: Created {{code}} v{{version}} (inactive). Activate it to put it on sale.

errors.name: Enter a name of 2–80 characters.
errors.price: Enter a price in rupees (up to ₹1,00,000, at most 2 decimals).
errors.credits: Enter a whole number of credits from 1 to 500.
errors.validityDays: Enter 1–3650 days, or leave empty for no expiry.
errors.features: List up to 10 features of 2–120 characters each.
errors.displayOrder: Enter a whole number from 0 to 1000.

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.subtitle: Discount codes candidates can apply at checkout. Changes are recorded in the audit log.
coupons.codeHint: 3–32 letters, digits or -; stored in upper case.
coupons.codeLocked: A coupon code cannot be changed.
coupons.planCodesHint: Leave all unticked to allow every purchasable plan.

errors.codeTaken: A coupon with this code already exists.
errors.valuePercent: Enter a whole percent from 1 to 100.
errors.valueFixed: Enter an amount in rupees (at most 2 decimals).
errors.validFrom: Enter a valid date and time.
errors.validTo: The end must be after the start.
errors.maxUses: Enter a whole number from 1, or leave empty for unlimited.
errors.perUserLimit: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.subtitle: Orders and payments. Open a purchase to see its payment history, refund it or reconcile it with the payment provider.
purchases.searchHint: Purchase id, user id, gateway order or payment id, or exact email.

detail.title: Purchase
detail.noPayment: No payment was started (free order or checkout not opened).

refund.title: Refund {{total}}?
refund.explainMoney: {{total}} is refunded in full to the original payment method through the payment provider.
refund.explainCredits_one: Any unused credit from this purchase ({{count}} credit granted) is withdrawn from the candidate.
refund.explainCredits_other: Any unused credits from this purchase ({{count}} credits granted) are withdrawn from the candidate.
refund.explainUsed: Credits already used stay with the candidate; their interviews and reports are not affected.
refund.acknowledge: I understand that unused credits are withdrawn and this cannot be undone.
refund.notRefundable: Only paid purchases with a captured payment can be refunded.

result.pending_one: Refund requested; the provider is still processing it. {{count}} credit was withdrawn.
result.pending_other: Refund requested; the provider is still processing it. {{count}} credits were withdrawn.
result.failed_one: The provider reported the refund as failed. {{count}} credit was withdrawn; check the provider dashboard.
result.failed_other: The provider reported the refund as failed. {{count}} credits were withdrawn; check the provider dashboard.

reconcile.hint: Checks the order with the payment provider and applies any payment, refund or expiry it missed.

outcome.PAID: Reconciled: the payment was captured and credits were issued.
outcome.REFUNDED: Reconciled: the provider reports this payment as refunded.
outcome.EXPIRED: Reconciled: the order was never paid and has expired.
outcome.PENDING: Reconciled: the payment is still pending with the provider.
outcome.AMOUNT_MISMATCH: Reconciled: the amount paid does not match the order. No credits were issued; investigate before acting.
outcome.UNCHANGED: Reconciled: nothing changed; the purchase already matches the provider.

recordings.title: Recordings
recordings.subtitle: Video recordings of interviews, kept privately until their retention date. Watching or deleting a recording is recorded in the audit log.
recordings.searchHint: Interview session id, user id or exact email.

detail.title: Recording
detail.missingHint: These parts never arrived, so playback skips them. The stored parts are kept.

player.title: Playback
player.logged: Viewing is logged: each time you open the player, your name and the time are recorded in the audit log.
player.expires: This link expires at {{at}}. Close and watch again for a new one.
player.deleted: This recording was deleted and can no longer be watched.
player.nothingStored: Nothing playable was stored for this recording.

purge.heading: Delete recording
purge.title: Delete this recording now?
purge.explainNow: The video is permanently deleted from storage now, before its retention date. It cannot be recovered.
purge.explainKept: The interview, its transcript and its report are not affected.
purge.acknowledge: I understand the video is permanently deleted and this cannot be undone.

integrity.title: Browser observations
integrity.note: These are browser events noted during the session. Most have ordinary explanations, such as a notification or a second screen. They are not part of the score.
integrity.empty: No browser events were noted for this interview.

events.TAB_VISIBLE_after: Returned to the interview tab after {{duration}}

consentTypeHint.VOICE_PROCESSING: Asked before voice and video interviews: answers are sent to speech providers and questions are read aloud.
consentTypeHint.RECORDING: Asked when a template records video: the camera and microphone are recorded and kept until the retention date.
consentTypeHint.INTEGRITY: Asked when a template notes tab switches, focus changes and pastes.

consent.title: Consent texts
consent.subtitle: The wording candidates accept before an interview, per consent and language. Versions are immutable: editing creates a new inactive version, and activating it makes it the one candidates see. Changes are recorded in the audit log.
consent.legalNote: Consent texts need legal review before launch. Only activate wording that has been approved.
consent.editorHint: Saving creates a new inactive version. Candidates keep seeing the current version until you activate the new one.
consent.noCurrent: No version is active, so candidates cannot be asked for this consent in this language.
consent.activateExplain: v{{version}} becomes the {{type}} text candidates see in {{locale}}, replacing the current version.
consent.activateReaccept: Candidates who accepted an earlier version must accept this one before their next interview starts.
consent.created: Created {{type}} ({{locale}}) v{{version}} (inactive). Activate it to show it to candidates.
consent.activated: {{type}} ({{locale}}) v{{version}} is now the current text.

list.title: Campaigns
list.subtitle: Invite candidates to the same interview through one link: one role, one interview type and the same rules for everyone. Results come back here. Changes are recorded in the audit log.

fields.name: Campaign name
fields.libraryCompanyHint: Optional. Links the campaign to a company in the library.
fields.roleHint: Only active roles with an active blueprint. The blueprint version is pinned when the campaign is created.
fields.templateHint: Only active interview types. Its current version is pinned when the campaign is created.
fields.startAtHint: Leave empty to start now. Candidates can join only once the campaign is activated.
fields.sponsoredCreditsHint: Optional. Empty means candidates use their own credits.
fields.tabSwitchTracking: Note when candidates leave the interview tab
fields.candidateSeesReport: Candidates can see their own report
fields.jobDescriptionHint: Optional. Shown to candidates and used to tailor their interview.

create.title: New campaign
create.hint: Campaigns start as drafts. Activate one when you are ready for candidates to join. The role, interview type and modes cannot change later.
create.libraryFailed: Could not load the roles, interview types or companies. Refresh and try again.

edit.title: Edit campaign settings
edit.hint: The role, interview type, modes, languages and proctoring stay as they were when the campaign was created.

invite.title: Invite link for {{name}}
invite.onceWarning: Copy this link now. It will not be shown again: only a fingerprint of it is stored. If it is lost, rotate the link to get a new one.
invite.pathOnly: The candidate site address is not configured for this console (VITE_CANDIDATE_URL), so only the path is shown. Add it after the candidate site address.
invite.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically. Select the link and copy it yourself.

detail.title: Campaign
detail.pinnedHint: Every candidate gets the same pinned versions, even if the library changes later.
detail.notSponsored: Not sponsored (candidates use their own credits)
detail.closed: This campaign is closed. Closing is final: it cannot be edited, reopened or given a new link.

explain.ACTIVE: Candidates with the invite link can join while the campaign is open.
explain.PAUSED: New candidates cannot join until you resume. Candidates who already joined can finish.
explain.CLOSED: Closing is final. Nobody can join again, and the campaign cannot be reopened or edited. Results stay available.

statusChange.acknowledgeClose: I understand that closing is final and cannot be undone.

rotate.title: Replace the invite link?
rotate.explain: A new link is created and shown once. The current link stops working immediately, so share the new one with anyone who has not joined yet.

exports.hint: The CSV uses the filters above. The package holds every candidate with their reports. Each download is recorded in the audit log.

errors.name: Enter a name of 3–120 characters.
errors.companyId: Choose a company from the list.
errors.companyName: Enter a company name of 2–120 characters.
errors.jobDescription: The job description is too long.
errors.endAt: The closing date must be after the opening date.
errors.maxCandidates: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100000, or leave it empty.
errors.tabSwitchTracking: Choose whether to note tab switches.
errors.candidateSeesReport: Choose whether candidates see their report.
errors.sponsoredCredits: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100000, or leave it empty.

list.title: Interviews
list.subtitle: Find interviews to review their transcript, evidence and scores. Opening an interview is recorded in the audit log.
list.searchHint: Interview id, user id or exact email.

detail.title: Interview
detail.audited: Your view of this interview is recorded in the audit log.

flag.title: Flag and actions
flag.flaggedDone: The interview is flagged for review.

rerun.explain: The evaluation is queued again for this interview, which is still processing.

scores.title: Scores
scores.hint: Each review adds a new revision with its own report. Revision 0 is the AI original and is never modified.

revise.notReviewable: Scores can be revised once the report is ready.
revise.title: Revise scores (from revision {{n}})
revise.hint: Change only the dimensions that need it. Each change needs a note explaining it. Leave a score empty to mark the dimension as not scored. Saving creates a new score and report revision; earlier revisions are kept unchanged.
revise.reason: Reason for this revision (recorded in the audit log)
revise.done: Revision {{n}} saved. A new report was generated from it.

errors.score: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100, or leave it empty.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.notComputed: No daily rollups have been computed for this range yet.
analytics.usdToInr: AI costs are converted at ₹{{rate}} per US dollar.

errors.order: The start date must not be after the end date.

kpis.title: Key metrics
kpis.rightNow: Right now, not for the range

funnel.title: Cohort funnel
funnel.explain: People who registered in the range and how far they got. Each step shows its conversion from the step before.
funnel.noConversion: no one reached the previous step

recompute.explain_one: Recompute the daily rollup for {{count}} day ({{from}} to {{to}}) from the source data.
recompute.explain_other: Recompute the daily rollups for {{count}} days ({{from}} to {{to}}) from the source data.

costs.title: Costs & margin
costs.subtitle: AI spend by feature, provider, model or day, with revenue and margin for the range (India-time days).
costs.empty: No AI calls in this range.
costs.marginChart: Daily revenue, AI cost and margin

system.readOnly: You can view this page; only super admins can change it.

health.title: System health
health.subtitle: Dependencies, background workers, queues and interview sessions. Refreshes every {{seconds}} seconds.
health.maintenanceOn: Maintenance mode is on: new interviews and campaign joins are blocked.
health.stuckWarning_one: {{count}} interview has been processing for more than 30 minutes.
health.stuckWarning_other: {{count}} interviews have been processing for more than 30 minutes.
health.noWorkers: No worker heartbeats: background jobs are not being processed.
health.staleWarning_one: {{count}} worker has not sent a heartbeat for over {{seconds}} seconds.
health.staleWarning_other: {{count}} workers have not sent a heartbeat for over {{seconds}} seconds.

queues.title: Queues
queues.subtitle: Background job counts per queue. Open a queue's failed jobs to inspect or retry them.
queues.failedExplain: The {{limit}} most recent failed jobs. Jobs carry ids only, never personal data.
queues.noFailed: No failed jobs in this queue.
queues.retryExplain: Retry job {{id}} in {{name}}? It runs again with the same data.
queues.goneRefreshed: Job {{id}} is no longer failed (it may already have been retried or removed). The list has been refreshed.

flags.title: Feature flags
flags.subtitle: Switch features on or off without a deployment. Every change is recorded in the audit log.
flags.rolloutExplain: A partial rollout applies only to signed-in users, and each user always gets the same result for a flag. Signed-out visitors see a partially rolled-out flag as off; 100% turns it on for everyone.
flags.rolloutInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100.

notes.publicProof: Turns on Candidate Proof: candidates can share a read-only link to their report.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: System-wide settings. Every change needs a reason and is recorded in the audit log.

maintenance.title: Maintenance mode
maintenance.explain: Shows a maintenance banner in the candidate app.
maintenance.warning: While on, new interviews cannot be started and campaign invites cannot be joined. Interviews already running continue.

hints.message: Up to 300 characters, shown to candidates.

finance.title: Finance
finance.explain: Converts AI costs (priced in US dollars) to rupees and estimates payment gateway fees for margins.

errors.usdToInr: Enter a rate above 0 and at most 1000.

targets.title: KPI targets
targets.explain: Targets shown on the dashboard. These are placeholders until the business sets them.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: Credentials for email, payments, file storage, SMS and the code judge. Every change needs a reason and is recorded in the audit log.

explain.encrypted: Keys and passwords are encrypted when saved and are never shown again; only their last 4 characters are displayed.
explain.immediate: Changes apply immediately on every server; no restart is needed.
explain.override: Settings saved here override the server file. “Use server file instead” removes them so the server file applies again.

integrations.serverFileValues: Values from the server file are not shown here.
integrations.secretTyped: Typing a value replaces the saved one; leave it empty to keep it.
integrations.testToHint: We send a short test message to this address.
integrations.resetExplain: This removes the {{name}} settings saved here, including keys and passwords. The server file applies again right away (or {{name}} stops working if the server file does not set it up).

errors.secretRequired: Required for {{provider}}; nothing is saved yet.
errors.secretCleared: Required for {{provider}}; enter a new value instead of clearing it.
errors.url: Enter an http(s) URL, for example https://judge.example.com.
errors.host: Enter a host name such as storage.bunnycdn.com.

email.title: Email
email.explain: Sends sign-in codes, receipts and notifications. Without it, candidates cannot sign in by email.

hints.smtpPort: Usually 587, or 465 with a secure connection.

payments.title: Payments
payments.explain: Takes payments for plans through Razorpay Checkout. Without it, candidates cannot buy plans.

hints.keyId: Public key id, starting with rzp_live_ or rzp_test_.
hints.webhookSecret: The secret you enter when creating the webhook in Razorpay.

payments.webhookUrl: Webhook URL to paste into Razorpay

storage.title: File storage
storage.explain: Stores résumés, recordings and other uploaded files.
storage.warning: Changing the storage zone after candidates have uploaded files makes their existing files unreachable.

hints.regionHost: storage.bunnycdn.com, or a regional host such as sg.storage.bunnycdn.com.
hints.accessKey: The storage zone password from the Bunny dashboard.

sms.title: SMS
sms.explain: Sends sign-in codes to mobile numbers.

hints.templateId: The DLT-approved template for sign-in codes.
hints.otpVariable: The template variable that holds the code. Default: otp.

judge.title: Code judge
judge.explain: Runs candidates’ code in coding rounds.
judge.note: Without a judge, coding rounds record the code without running it.

hints.baseUrl: The http(s) address of the judge.
hints.hmacSecret: At least 32 characters. The judge’s verifying proxy must use the same secret.
